name: Panambur Beach
description: A broad stretch of coast north of the city, known for its open views of the Arabian Sea. Leave time for a slow walk along the water and check local advisories before swimming.

name: Tannirbhavi Beach
tagline: A quieter side of the city.
description: A long, sandy shoreline across the Gurupura river estuary from central Mangaluru. It makes a lovely pause for sea air; check ferry and access conditions for your travel date.
infoStatus: Access and ferry status may vary

name: Sultan Battery
description: A compact stone watchtower overlooking the Gurupura river mouth. Pair the short heritage stop with a walk around Boloor or a visit toward the coast.

name: Kadri Manjunath Temple
description: A historic hilltop temple set among greenery in the city. Visitors should check current temple timings and follow local customs before arrival.
infoStatus: Check temple timings and visitor guidance

name: St Aloysius Chapel
tagline: Look up. There’s a story overhead.
description: A chapel on Lighthouse Hill celebrated for its richly painted interior. Confirm current visiting hours and any photography guidance before planning your stop.

name: Mangaladevi Temple
tagline: The city’s namesake, still at its heart.
description: A historic temple associated with the origin of the name Mangaluru. Check current visiting hours, dress expectations, and local guidance before visiting.
infoStatus: Check temple timings and visitor guidance

name: Kudroli Gokarnath Temple
tagline: A vivid landmark in the city.
description: A prominent temple complex in central Mangaluru, known for its colourful architecture and festival traditions. Verify timings and event dates directly with local sources.

name: Someshwara Beach
tagline: Rocky headlands and a wide sea.
description: A dramatic coastal stretch south of the city, with rocky formations and expansive sea views. Ocean conditions can be hazardous; follow local safety notices and avoid entering the water where advised.
infoStatus: Check beach safety and sea conditions

name: Pilikula Nisargadhama
tagline: A green day with room to roam.
description: A broad nature and culture destination outside the city centre, with several attractions in one area. Check which facilities are open and their current schedules before setting aside a day.

name: Sammilan Shetty Butterfly Park
tagline: A small world with delicate wings.
description: A conservation-focused butterfly park in the wider Mangaluru region. It is farther from the city; contact the park to confirm visiting days, access, and seasonal activity.
infoStatus: Confirm visiting days and seasonal activity

name: Central Market
description: A lively city-market area for seeing everyday Mangaluru in motion and discovering local produce. Market hours and individual vendor availability vary; ask before making a special trip.

name: Sasihithlu Beach
tagline: Where river, estuary, and sea meet.
description: A coastal landscape north of Mangaluru where river and sea shape a quieter shoreline. Check current access, sea conditions, and local guidance before visiting.
infoStatus: Check access and beach safety locally
